fragment-unicode-stripping.name: Fragment unicode stripping
fragment-unicode-stripping.description: One parser strips or corrupts raw unicode in fragment while the other preserves or percent-encodes it

fragment-percent-encoding.name: Fragment percent-encoding
fragment-percent-encoding.description: One parser percent-encodes fragment while other uses raw unicode or different encoding

multiple-hash-handling.name: Multiple hash handling
multiple-hash-handling.description: One parser uses first # as fragment boundary, other uses last # in the URL

fragment-leading-hash.name: Fragment leading hash inclusion
fragment-leading-hash.description: One parser includes the leading # in the fragment, the other strips it
